description: Mass- and charge-balanced reaction networks underpinning metabolic reconstruction across plants, fungi and microbes. This release publishes four thermodynamic sources independently per reaction, each with its own energy, uncertainty and inferred direction, and grades every reaction gold, silver or bronze on the strength of the evidence behind it. Data derived exclusively from a single external resource remains subject to that resource's terms, which are enumerated in LICENSE.
